title: cybernetics
description: The discipline-label for the body of work on regulation, control, feedback, and self-organization initiated by Norbert Wiener (1948). Disciplines are not substrate-categorical objects; this placement admits the label without deriving it. Cybernetics-the-discipline is generated by its constituent concepts (cybernetic-feedback, requisite-variety, ultrastability, autopoiesis, etc.), each of which has its own substrate-derived placement.
